title: Simon Interviewed for Dutch Newspaper
text: Simon was interviewed by Dutch newspaper 'Het Parool' discussing cognitive control, brain mechanisms, and conscious decision-making.
The Open Science Award of the Faculty of Behavioural and Movement Sciences at the Free University Amsterdam was awarded to Johannes Fahrenfort for developing the open-source ADAM decoding toolbox.
title: Johannes Receives Faculty's Open Science Award

text: Johannes was interviewed about hypnosis and visual perception for the kids science TV show 'Proefkonijnen' (guinea pigs). You can watch the video excerpt on our website.
title: Johannes Interviewed for Kids TV 'Proefkonijnen'

text: This year we had not one but two PNAS publications! Very proud of Nico and Lola who did all the hard work on these projects exploring perceptual consciousness.
title: Two PNAS Publications in One Year
Simon Receives an ERC Consolidator Grant
text: We are happy to consolidate our work on the neural mechanisms of consciousness! Simon van Gaal has been awarded a €2 million ERC Consolidator Grant.
The Templeton Foundation funds developing a valid statistical framework for establishing unconscious processing and testing adversarial predictions.
title: Johannes Receives Templeton ARC Grant

text: We are super proud to have organized ASSC 25 in Amsterdam. The conference was a huge success, welcoming over 500 consciousness researchers from across the globe.
title: The Conscious Brain Lab Organizes ASSC 25
